summary: Continues the TAIEX case studies 2000-2005 (weekly and daily): a double top with equal-distance two-wave decline target and 带量破底翻 bottom; 2001 false-breakout shorts with decline targets; the 2001 gap-up neckline breakout and 2002 price/volume divergence plus false-breakout top; a converging-triangle bottom with 破底翻 then 带量突破颈线 and big-wave target; the 2004 '3·19' shock where the main players' escape rally (逃命波) is explained and breakdown with vs without volume is compared; and a 2005 破底翻 with measured target, false breakout and decline target. Each case gives entry, stop, % risk and % profit.

patterns.name_zh: 双头（头部）跌破颈线 + 两波跌幅满足
patterns.name_en: Double top neckline breakdown with two-wave decline target (weekly)
patterns.structure: Two highs 10393.59 and 10328.98 (Feb 2000 top area), neckline ~8385 (lows 8250.46/8281.68 rising line); weekly break of neckline week of 2000/7/1.
patterns.stop: Stop risk ~6% (level not stated explicitly; presumably reclaim of the neckline).

target.formula: height = midpoint of the two tops - neckline; target_1 = breakdown - height; target_2 = target_1 - height.

confirmation: No stabilisation sign -> catching rebounds is risky; bear ran straight two waves.

patterns.name_en: False breakout short (falls back below the line next day)
patterns.structure: A rebound pushes above a prior high/upper line, then immediately (next day) falls back below the line (隔日跌回线下).
patterns.entry: Short when the false breakout is confirmed by falling back below the line (2001/2/16 ~5940; 2001/8/20 ~4540; 2002/5/4 week ~5980).
patterns.stop: Above the false breakout's high (6198; 4715; weekly high 6258); risks 4.3%, 3.8%, ~5%.

target.formula: After breaking the rebound low L: target = rebound_high - (prior_high - L) (等幅跌幅满足).

confirmation: Next-day fall back below the line.
Decline target computed only after breaking the reaction low.
invalidation: Price breaks above the false-breakout high.

patterns.name_zh: 跳空长红突破颈线底部确立
patterns.name_en: Gap-up long red neckline breakout confirming a bottom
patterns.structure: Short base at the decline target (3411.68); 2001/10/11 gap-up long red breaks the bottom neckline, ending the 6198 bear and the 10393 long decline.

target.formula: Once the first leg peaks and price pulls back then re-breaks: target = pullback low + (first-leg high - low).

confirmation: Occurs at a computed decline target.

patterns.name_zh: 量价背离后的假突破头部
patterns.name_en: Price/volume divergence then false breakout top
patterns.structure: After target is reached, ~2 months of chop, then a slow grind higher with clearly falling volume (价涨量缩). Late April 2002 false breakout at 6484.93 above 6326.43; 5/2 long black breaks the rising neckline (from 5320.40/5492.94/6009.45).
patterns.entry: False breakout + long black neckline break = long-term sell signal (operation given in the weekly case: short 2002/5/4 week ~5980).
patterns.stop: Weekly high 6258 (risk ~5%) per the weekly case.

target.worked_example: Fell to near the start of the rise (low 3845).

confirmation: Long black candle breaking the neckline after the false breakout.

patterns.name_zh: 收敛三角形底部 + 破底翻 + 带量突破颈线
patterns.name_en: Converging-triangle bottom with break-bottom reversal and volume breakout (weekly)
patterns.structure: ~Half-year base after the 3845.76 low: descending upper line from 5460/5141.80, rising lower line from 3845.76 to 4044.73; short range ~4240-4413. Week of 2003/5/31 turns red and reclaims the line = 破底翻; 3 weeks later (6/21) breaks the triangle neckline with volume (volume rising above a declining volume trendline).
patterns.entry: Buy the 破底翻 week (~4470); add on the volume neckline breakout (~4930). Later, 2004/1/10 week volume breakout of a consolidation neckline -> buy back (~6150).
patterns.stop: 破底翻 entry: break of the pre-break low 4240 (~5%). Breakout add: break of neckline = prior week's low 4715 (~4.5%). 2004 re-entry: neckline ~6020 (~2%).

target.formula: Triangle target = breakout + side length (3845 to the side's upper point ~5260). Big-wave target = new low + (prior up-wave), activated by breaking prior high 6484.

confirmation: Volume expansion on the breakout (带量突破颈线).

patterns.name_zh: 突发利空后的主力逃命波 + 带量破线翻空
patterns.name_en: Main-player escape rally after an unexpected shock, then volume breakdown
patterns.structure: At a big-wave target (7135, March 2004) the top-area chop is too short for main players to distribute; the 3·19 shooting shock gaps the market down; players can't exit, so a ~1-month rally returns to near the shock's starting high (6916.31) for an escape rally; 2004/4/22 long black breaks with volume = distribution done.
patterns.stop: Above the long black's high (text: 6912; chart label 6916.31), risk ~3%.

target.formula: No measured target given; covered when 8/19 volume long red breaks the downtrend line/consolidation neckline (bottom confirmed).

confirmation: Volume on the breakdown candle (带量).
Rally back to the shock's starting point before breaking.

patterns.name_zh: 破线不带量（中期修正而非长空）
patterns.name_en: Breakdown without volume = intermediate correction, not long bear
patterns.structure: 2004/5/5 long black breaks an ~8-month large neckline, but without volume; the decline is shallow, a mid-term correction ending with 8/19 volume long red breaking the ~1-month range neckline and reclaiming the neckline = 破底翻 (low 5255.06).
patterns.entry: Cover shorts / bottom confirmation on the 8/19 带量长红 breakout (带量破底翻).
confirmation: Volume on the reclaim (带量站回颈线).

patterns.name_zh: 破底翻 + 涨幅满足 + 假突破（2005）
patterns.name_en: Break-bottom reversal, measured target, false breakout (2005 daily)
patterns.structure: 2005/4/18 breaks the long-term consolidation neckline (rising line from 5597.80/5722.18/5734.87) to 5565.41; 5/5 volume long red 破底翻 stabilises; early June breaks the range (6001 high, 5879 low).
patterns.entry: 破底翻 / range breakout (no explicit entry price on read pages).

target.worked_example: 6001 - 5565 = 436; 5879 + 436 = 6315 (high 6401.81 mid-June, then high-level chop; 6481.62 false breakout and break of rising trendline; chart marks 跌幅满足 near 5618.90 low).

confirmation: Volume long red on the reclaim.

rules.rule: Double-top measured move uses the midpoint of the two tops minus the neckline.
rules.quote_zh: 10393点与10328点双头两个高点，连成直线的中间位置约在10360点附近。

rules.rule: Before a bear shows signs of stabilising, catching rebounds is high risk; the decline can run two waves directly.
rules.quote_zh: 而这波空头直接进行两波跌幅，可见空头未见企稳迹象前抢反弹风险颇高

rules.rule: A wider stop (~6%) can be acceptable for a larger swing profit.
rules.quote_zh: 而7月1日跌破颈线做空的停损风险约6%，风险稍高，但波段获利更大，约44%。

rules.rule: Bottoms at a decline target are confirmed by a volume 破底翻.
rules.quote_zh: 要注意台股当年底达跌幅满足附近（最低4555点），才出现带量破底翻做较大幅度反弹。

rules.rule: Decline target after breaking the reaction low.
rules.quote_zh: 跌破短期反弹低点4902点，便能计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: False breakout is confirmed when price falls back below the line the next day; short with stop above the prior high.
rules.quote_zh: 突破后隔日立即跌回线下，假突破确立空单进场，约可空在5940点附近，突破前高6198点停损，风险约4.3%

rules.rule: After reaching the target, stay on the sidelines until a definite direction appears.
rules.quote_zh: 达涨幅满足后未出现确定的方向前，以观望为主。

rules.rule: Once price/volume divergence appears, watch for a turn.
rules.quote_zh: 当量价背离的结构出现后，再来注意转折的出现。

rules.rule: A false breakout is itself a turning signal.
False breakout + long black neckline break = long-term sell signal and top confirmation.
rules.quote_zh: 尤其在5月2日长黑摜破颈线，确立了假突破的长线卖出信号，同时也确立头部

rules.rule: 破底翻 stop is the low before the break (破底前的前低); the volume neckline breakout is the add-on with stop at the neckline / prior week's low.
rules.quote_zh: 约可买在4470点附近，跌破破底前的前低4240点，停损风险约5%，3周后6月21日当周带量突破颈线加码买进

rules.rule: Breaking the prior high enables the big-wave target.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面突破前高6484点，便可计算大波段涨幅满足。

rules.rule: When an unexpected bad-news shock traps main players, they usually stage a rally back near the shock's starting point to escape; the real decline comes after they exit.
rules.quote_zh: 利空短线大跌后，大多还是会拉高到利空起跌点附近，做主力解套的逃命波，主力跑了才真正会大幅回跌。

rules.rule: Main players need a long enough high-level chop to distribute; too short a top is vulnerable.
rules.quote_zh: 一波多头行情需在高档震荡一段期间，主力筹码才有较充裕的出货时间

rules.rule: The day's high of the volume long-black breakdown is the short stop.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面当日高点6912点已成反压，是翻空操作的空头停损点

rules.rule: A volume long-black breakdown after the escape rally is the distribution-complete exit signal.
rules.quote_zh: 4月22日带量长黑破线，便是主力出货完毕的退出翻空信号

rules.rule: A neckline breakdown without volume tends to produce only a mid-term correction, not a long bear.
rules.quote_zh: 接下来的这次的长黑破线并未带量，因此虽然破线也完成的反弹逃命线型态，短中期盘弱持续空头走势，但随后的跌幅并不太深，未出现长空走势而是中期修正

rules.rule: Discipline: most traders fail for lack of discipline, not knowledge (Kostolany); psychology drives 90% of the market; Soros: correct mistakes immediately.
rules.quote_zh: 多数的交易员因为缺乏纪律而遭致失败而非因知识不足而失败。

worked_examples.outcome: Short 2000/7/1 week, risk ~6%, profit ~44%; 带量破底翻 at 4555.
Short1 risk ~4.3%, profit ~32%; short2 (2001/8/20) risk ~3.8%, profit ~21%; 10/11 gap long red ended the bear.

worked_examples.pattern: 跳空长红突破颈线 + 涨幅满足 + 量价背离 + 假突破
worked_examples.outcome: Long 2001/10/11 risk ~4%, profit ~51%; 2002 false breakout + 5/2 long black -> fall to ~3845.

worked_examples.pattern: 假突破 + 跌幅满足 + 收敛三角形底 + 破底翻 + 带量突破 + 大波段涨幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Short ~36%; longs 26%-39% to 6224; re-entry ~15% to the big-wave target; ended by 3·19 shock.

worked_examples.pattern: 利空逃命波 + 带量破线 + 破线不带量 + 带量破底翻
worked_examples.outcome: Short 4/22 risk ~3%, covered 8/19 for ~17%; then >1 year of range trading.

worked_examples.pattern: 破底翻 + 涨幅满足 + 假突破 + 跌幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Reached target (6401); false breakout at 6481.62 and decline target near 5618.90 (operation details continue in the next unit).

quantifiable: Double top target: mid = (top1+top2)/2; h = mid - neckline; t1 = breakdown - h; t2 = t1 - h.
False breakout short: close above prior high H then close back below the line within 1 bar; stop = max high of the false breakout; risk 3.8%-5%.
Activate decline target only after close < reaction low; target = rebound_high - (prior_high - reaction_low).
Volume breakdown classifier: breakdown bar volume > k x 20-bar average => expect long bear; otherwise expect mid-term correction (shallower decline).
Volume breakout confirmation: breakout bar volume above a declining volume trendline / recent average.
破底翻 stop = low of the range before the break (前低), not the extreme low.
Shock-rally rule: after a gap-down shock at a target, expect a rally to the shock-start high within ~1 month; short a volume long-black break after that.
After target reached with no confirmed direction, no new position (flat).
ambiguities: p138 gives triangle target 6225 in 观察重点二 but 6224 in 操作方式.
p140 text uses 6912 for the 4/22 high; the chart (p139) labels 6916.31.
Stop level for the 2000/7/1 double-top short is given only as ~6% risk.
Triangle side length is measured to 'about 5260' on the upper line; how to pick that point is vague.
2005 case: entry/stop and false-breakout operation not given on these pages (likely continued in u14c).
'6月中旬' high 6401 per text; chart shows 6401.81 around late June.
